summary: Discovered the real topology (node1 has 3 NICs: eth0=shared default net, eth1↔node2, eth2↔node3, both dhcp:false/egress:false private links requiring manual addressing); assigned static IPs and routes so node2/node3 route through node1, opened firewalld on the private NICs, applied a VyOS QoS HTB shaper (1Mbit rate/ceiling) on node1's eth2 egress (the node3-facing interface), and validated with iperf3 that node2→node3 is capped at ~1 Mbit/s while node3→node2 remains unrestricted (~1-20+ Gbit/s). All three nodes were then restarted one at a time via native reboot, with boot-id changes proving actual restarts, and post-restart verification confirmed IP config, routes, firewall zones, VyOS QoS shaping, and the required asymmetric throughput behavior all persisted.
actions_performed: Inspected topology on all 3 nodes; found node1 has eth0/eth1/eth2, node2/node3 have eth0/eth1 with eth1 unconfigured
Assigned static IP 10.10.12.1/24 (eth1) and 10.10.13.1/24 (eth2) on VyOS node1 via configure/commit/save
Assigned static IP 10.10.12.2/24 on node2 eth1 and 10.10.13.2/24 on node3 eth1 via nmcli, with static routes to the peer's subnet via node1
Fixed firewalld: moved eth1 to 'trusted' zone on node2 and node3 (public zone was REJECTing new TCP with 'No route to host')
Installed iperf3 on node2 and node3, measured baseline throughput both directions (~21-22 Gbit/s)
Researched current VyOS QoS ('set qos policy shaper') syntax via web search/fetch since it postdates training data
Applied VyOS QoS shaper policy LIMIT-TO-NODE3 (default bandwidth/ceiling 1mbit) as egress on node1 eth2 (interface facing node3)
Verified via tc class show that eth2 has an HTB class rate/ceil 1Mbit
Re-ran iperf3: node2->node3 capped at ~1.0-1.3 Mbit/s; node3->node2 unrestricted (~1.5 Gbit/s)
Captured boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes, then restarted node1, then node2, then node3 one at a time via native reboot
Polled each node until exec was available again and confirmed boot_id changed on all three
Post-restart verified IP addressing, routes, firewalld zone, VyOS QoS/tc shaper persisted, and re-ran iperf3 both directions confirming shaping behavior survived reboot on all nodes

evidence.requirement: Real topology discovery (node1 routes node2<->node3, not the flat default net initially observed)
evidence.summary: Confirmed node1 has 3 NICs (eth0/eth1/eth2) and node2/node3 each have an unconfigured eth1; firewalld showed eth1 present, revealing the intended private-network topology

evidence.requirement: Static addressing and routing configured so node2<->node3 traffic actually transits node1
evidence.summary: Assigned IPs on node1 eth1/eth2, node2/node3 eth1, added static routes; ping node2->node3 showed TTL=63 confirming one-hop routing via node1
iperf3 measured ~21.7 Gbit/s node2->node3 and ~21.6 Gbit/s node3->node2 before any shaping was applied

evidence.requirement: Apply 1 Mbit/s limit on node2->node3 traffic only, leaving node3->node2 unrestricted
evidence.summary: Configured VyOS QoS shaper (bandwidth/ceiling 1mbit) as egress on node1 eth2 (node3-facing interface); tc class show confirmed 'rate 1Mbit ceil 1Mbit'; iperf3 showed node2->node3 throttled to ~1.13 Mbit/s while node3->node2 stayed at ~1.54 Gbit/s

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state (QoS shaping, forwarding)
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 5bcff8f9..., issued reboot, node became unreachable then reachable again with new boot_id b41c3968..., and post-restart eth1/eth2 addressing, ip_forward=1, and the 1Mbit HTB class on eth2 were all confirmed intact

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state (addressing, routes, firewall)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 54bd1c3e... captured, reboot triggered, node came back with new boot_id 25322907..., and eth1 IP/route to 10.10.13.0/24 and firewalld 'trusted' zone on eth1 all persisted

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state (addressing, routes, firewall)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e31962a9... captured, reboot triggered, node came back with new boot_id 40c231ca..., eth1 IP/route to 10.10.12.0/24 and firewalld 'trusted' zone persisted

evidence.requirement: End-to-end functional recovery of the traffic-shaping requirement after all three restarts
evidence.summary: Post-restart iperf3 confirmed node2->node3 still capped (~1.27 Mbit/s) and node3->node2 still unrestricted (~1.17 Gbit/s)
